Two sitemap Christmas URLs (christmas-tree-skirts, christmas-crackers) now 301-redirect to the Christmas hub - stale/removed, not live categories, excluded. Guessed URLs for Valentine's Day, New Year, Black Friday, Diwali, Eid, and Bonfire Night (both /category/<slug> and /category/seasonal/<slug> forms) all returned Dunelm's generic soft-404 "notfound" template (verified via embedded notFound/noResults flags and generic <title>Dunelm | The UK's Leading Home Furnishings Retailer</title>) - confirmed absent, not live on the site, consistent with the category sitemap which has no such entries.
